evidence.environment: Codex CLI on a separate Linux host; sde-agents 1.6.0 skills half via nested plugin; agents via install_codex_agents.py and /import
evidence.source_reference: GitHub issue #61; docs/decisions/2026-07-30-multi-platform-packaging.md consequences; operator host confirmation 2026-08-02

expected_behavior: Plain-language onboarding intent is measurably routable on every host that ships the fleet, or the unmeasured lane's routing limits are documented where users of that lane see them.
observation: A real Codex-host workload (SEC-01) hit a plain-language routing failure to service-onboard although the routing sentence ships in the generated Codex agent; the 2026-07-30 packaging decision scopes routing evals to canonical Claude descriptions and leaves non-Claude runtime behavior to manual smoke checks, so no existing measurement could catch the miss.
reason: Promoted on landed evidence for the documentation limb: PR #107 shipped the model-visible onboarding-map skill and README.md's Codex-lane subsection stating that lane's two discovery limits, explicit-only skills being invisible to the model and custom agents being reached only by explicit request, and naming onboarding-map as the deliberate repair while keeping discovery, recommendation, activation and execution distinct. That text sits where installers of the lane read it. Deliberately not claimed: the measurement limb, plain-language intent measurably routable on a Codex host, is unmet and stays owed by roadmap item LANE-001, which remains ready with its host-evidence gates open. Promoting this record does not close that item.
